desc: The new TriStar Setter is the ultimate in affordability. This Over and Under, 3" shotgun is designed to give maximum performance at minimum cost. The Setter is TriStar's first double trigger, extractor shotgun. Other features include, laser-cut checkering, solid steal receiver, brass bead front sight, and chrome-lined barrels. Comes with 3 Beretta® style chokes (IC, M, F). .
